response.justification: Bogdan is a versatile, experienced senior/staff engineer with strong full-stack, TDD, and open-source credentials, and has some geospatial exposure via GISCollective. However, his recent professional experience is overwhelmingly in TypeScript/Node.js/web stacks, with C++ limited to a role that ended over a decade ago and no evident Rust experience. There is no indication of distributed-systems, routing-tile, or navigation-pipeline work matching the core technical requirements of this role.
strengths: Strong generalist engineer with broad language and platform experience
Some geospatial/GIS domain exposure via GISCollective and Green Map projects
Demonstrated ability to work across the stack and learn new technologies quickly
concerns: C++ experience is minimal and outdated (last used ~2014-2015)
No evidence of Rust or systems-level distributed computing experience
No direct experience with routing/navigation data pipelines or tile generation at scale

key_factors.factor: No routing/navigation pipeline or distributed systems experience
